sentences.en: How will they amuse the children on a wet afternoon?
sentences.zh: 在一个下雨的下午他们将怎样娱乐孩子们？

sentences.en: Instead she merely looked surprised and - could it be - amused.
sentences.zh: 她只是看上去很惊讶，并且——可能是——觉得有趣。

sentences.en: Any book will do as long as it is amusing.
sentences.zh: 只要能逗乐人，什么书都行。

senses.zh: 逗乐, 逗笑, （提供）消遣, （使）娱乐
